title: Visa TAP actors and trust boundaries
caption: Five trust zones. Visa onboards agents, runs the key store and signs the ID Token; the agent holds its signing key; the request can pass a Checkout Enabler and a CDN before the merchant; money moves through the card network outside TAP.
alt: Flowchart with five zones. Agent provider zone: the AI agent and its private key, which signs headers and body objects. Visa zone: VIC onboarding, which registers the key in the key store at mcp.visa.com/.well-known/jwks, the ID Token signer and VIC tokens, passkeys and instructions, which supply credentials to the agent. Path zone: a Checkout Enabler that passes requests through and a Site Protection Provider (CDN). The agent sends a signed request through the Checkout Enabler to the CDN, which fetches the key by keyid from the key store and forwards the verified request to the merchant. The merchant verifies the body objects and ID Token with keys from the key store, decrypts the payload with its own key, and authorizes the payment through the acquirer and Visa network.
